instruction: Configure VLC to cap the volume slider at 200% to avoid unintentional speaker damage from higher volumes.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the maximum volume slider value in VLC to 200% by configuring qt-max-volume=200 in the VLC configuration file. The existing metric function check_qt_max_volume validates this setting. Default value is 125, so the agent must change it to 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file containing qt-max-volume setting
Metric correctly parses the config file and compares qt-max-volume to expected value '200'
Expected value '200' semantically matches the instruction requirement (limit max volume to 200%)
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes are persistent and applied
Metric parameter handling is correct - directly accesses rule dictionary as expected for type='rule'
Complete coverage - instruction has one requirement and evaluator checks that requirement
Robust implementation with proper defaults, type handling, and error handling
